citation: HL7 v2.4 Chapter 4, section 4.13.11 RAS - pharmacy/treatment administration message (event O17), p 4-85. Unprinted group names (ADR-019 decision 3): PATIENT (HL7-xml v2.4/RAS_O17.xsd, RAS_O17.PATIENT.CONTENT), PATIENT_VISIT (HL7-xml v2.4/RAS_O17.xsd, RAS_O17.PATIENT_VISIT.CONTENT), ORDER (HL7-xml v2.4/RAS_O17.xsd, RAS_O17.ORDER.CONTENT), ORDER_DETAIL (HL7-xml v2.4/RAS_O17.xsd, RAS_O17.ORDER_DETAIL.CONTENT), ORDER_DETAIL_SUPPLEMENT (HL7-xml v2.4/RAS_O17.xsd, RAS_O17.ORDER_DETAIL_SUPPLEMENT.CONTENT), COMPONENTS (HL7-xml v2.4/RAS_O17.xsd, RAS_O17.COMPONENTS.CONTENT), ENCODING (HL7-xml v2.4/RAS_O17.xsd, RAS_O17.ENCODING.CONTENT), ADMINISTRATION (overrides.json: HL7 v2.4 Chapter 4, section 4.13.11 RAS - pharmacy/treatment administration message (event O17), p 4-85: the unnamed group with first segment RXA at [ORDER] (v2.4 prints no group names); named ADMINISTRATION from HL7-xml v2.5.1/RAS_O17.xsd, RAS_O17.ADMINISTRATION.CONTENT, the group with the same parent path, first segment and member set; HL7-xml v2.4/RAS_O17.xsd lists RXA, RXR and OBSERVATION ungrouped under ORDER (a bundle-differs row) (P8b-13 ruling 3).) and OBSERVATION (overrides.json: HL7 v2.4 Chapter 4, section 4.13.11 RAS - pharmacy/treatment administration message (event O17), p 4-85: the unnamed group with first segment OBX at [ORDER, ADMINISTRATION] (v2.4 prints no group names); named OBSERVATION, as HL7-xml v2.4/RAS_O17.xsd, RAS_O17.OBSERVATION.CONTENT names the group with the same first segment and member set (under ORDER) and HL7-xml v2.5.1/RAS_O17.xsd, RAS_O17.OBSERVATION.CONTENT names it under ORDER/ADMINISTRATION (P8b-13 ruling 3).).
